features: Auto-save form draft to localStorage every 5s
manual_steps: Ensure TEST_MODE=true is set in environment for verification worker
Set SMTP_URL for production email notifications (optional in dev)
Set HF_TOKEN if using Hugging Face for AI verification (optional)
notes: All forms save draft to localStorage every 5 seconds to prevent data loss
Verification worker must be running with TEST_MODE for e2e tests
Rate limiting is in-memory for development (use Redis in production)
All buttons use icon + label for accessibility
Password validation enforces 10+ chars with number/symbol requirement
